messages.content: You help plan tasks. Use the language of the user's question.
I want to build a full-stack web app, frontend in React, backend in Go. List a 7-day learning roadmap with daily content and exercises. Be bilingual: key terms in both English and 中文.

message.content:
# Full-Stack Web Development Roadmap ## React (Frontend) + Go (Backend) | 7天学习计划 --- ## 📅 Day 1: Environment Setup & Foundations ### 环境搭建与基础 **Content:** | Topic | English | 中文 | |-------|---------|------| | Development Environment | IDE/Editor Setup (VS Code) | 集成开发环境配置 | | Node.js & npm | Node.js & npm Installation | Node.js 和 npm 安装 | | Go Installation | Go SDK Setup | Go SDK 安装 | | Version Control | Git Basics | Git 基础 | **Learning Objectives:** - Install and configure VS Code / GoLand - Set up Node.js (v18+) and Go (v1.21+) - Create project directories - Initialize Git repository **Exercise 练习:** ```bash # Terminal commands mkdir fullstack-project cd fullstack-project git init ``` --- ## 📅 Day 2: React Fundamentals ### React 基础 **Content:** | Term | English | 中文 | |------|---------|------| | JSX | JavaScript XML | JSX 语法 | | Component | Functional Component | 函数组件 | | Props | Properties | 属性传递 | | State | Component State | 组件状态 | **Learning Objectives:** - Understand JSX syntax - Create functional components - Pass and use props - Use useState hook **Exercise 练习:** ```jsx // Create a simple greeting component function Greeting({ name }) { const [count, setCount] = useState(0); return (

Hello, {name}!

Count: {count}

); } ``` **Mini Project 小项目:** Counter App (计数器) --- ## 📅 Day 3: React Advanced Concepts ### React 高级概念 **Content:** | Term | English | 中文 | |------|---------|------| | Hooks | React Hooks | React 钩子 | | Effect | useEffect | 副作用钩子 | | Context | Context API | 上下文 API | | Conditional Rendering | Conditional Rendering | 条件渲染 | | List Rendering | List & Keys | 列表渲染与 Keys | **Learning Objectives:** - Master useEffect for side effects -
